human_claim: Every compact complex manifold admitting a Kahler form whose de Rham cohomology class is integral admits a holomorphic embedding into a finite-dimensional complex projective space.

quantifier_scope.input: a finite-dimensional compact complex manifold X
quantifier_scope.hypothesis: there exists a Kahler form omega on X with [omega] in the image of H^2(X, Z) -> H^2_dR(X, R)
quantifier_scope.conclusion: there exist n : Nat and a holomorphic embedding X -> complex projective n-space

degenerate_cases: Disconnected manifolds require an explicit convention or componentwise treatment.
Zero-dimensional compact complex manifolds are included unless the primary source imposes positive dimension.
The normalization of the integral class (for example a 2*pi factor) must be fixed at statement phase.
